skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Stranded in Utopia
skins.content: Iteration Provident/Stranded in Utopia. Haruka's iteration from decision point F/3019226. Following the Goldfins' guidance, she presses on toward the sound of the temari song, finally beholding the princess waiting for visitors in the deepest reaches of utopia.
skins.quote: A single instant here is countless days outside. Let the jeweled box she holds tell you the ending of the dream.
